correctness.rationale: The bidegree-(2,2) projective harmonic representation branches multiplicity-free under U(1)xU(d-1) into nine types, six conjugate-paired concentration eigenvalues; normalized Jacobi-square Beta integrals yield the polynomial branches. The nine sector dimensions sum to binomial(d+1,2)^2-d^2. Exact positive factorizations show lambda_22=(1-t)^(d+3) strictly least for d>=3, 0<t<1; limiting envelope comparisons yield s=2 and 2+sqrt(2) with the four-sector tie at s=2. Independently recomputed all 18 exact rational Jacobi/Beta integrals for d=3,4,7 at t=2/5 (six sectors each). These finite checks corroborate but do not replace all-parameter separation and polynomial sign proofs.
residual_risks: The representation-theoretic separated-function identification and gamma/Jacobi normalization are essential nontrivial premises; checked against standard Jacobi separation and exact derivatives rather than treating finite tests as infinite proof.
